name: 火山方舟
desc: 火山引擎企业级大模型服务平台
desc_zh: 火山引擎企业级大模型服务平台
solves: Enterprises want the models, but serving, scaling and access control all have to be built first. Here they are hosted and you call them through an API.
solves_zh: 企业想用大模型，但推理、扩容和权限都要自己搭。这里托管起来，接口直接调。
best_for: When you need to call models reliably in production without running the inference stack.
best_for_zh: 企业要在生产环境稳定调用大模型，不想自己运维推理服务。
